This is a study aid, not a clinical tool. Nothing in it is meant to guide decisions about a real patient's care. Five for a quick drill, twenty when you have time. Answer from six options, or name it yourself and score your own recall. Switch on re-asking and a murmur you miss comes back a few questions later, because that is the one you needed to hear again.
